# Agents, skills & plans **A live side pane for Claude Code that shows what your agents are doing** — the plan each session is working through, the subagents it spawned, the skills it called and the tools they use — across every open session, as a list or as a graph.

## What you get - **Every session in one place.** Each open Claude Code session publishes its state; the pane shows them all, with yours framed on top and the others below, each foldable. - **Plans, live.** The step list Claude keeps for a task, with the current step pulsing. Replaced plans are kept under *Past plans*, dropped steps struck through. - **Subagents where they belong.** Each subagent hangs off the plan step it was spawned under, with its status, running time and its busiest tools (`Grep 21`, `Read 7` …). The tool it is using right now is outlined. - **Skills too.** Skills the conversation calls appear as pills under their step (◆ active, ◇ used, red on error, `×2` when repeated); skills a subagent calls sit on its card. - **List or graph.** A compact list for narrow panes, or an animated graph: flowing edges to running agents, pulsing steps. - **Token usage.** Each subagent shows the tokens it has used (`142.8k tokens`), and each session the tokens in its context window (`152.4k in context`). Turn it off under ⚙. Per-subagent counts need a Claude Code build that reports them; on older builds only the session's count shows. - **Codex and Gemini too.** When Claude (or one of its subagents) runs `codex` or `gemini` through Bash, the run gets a card of its own, with its model and tokens, and the agents *it* spawns hang under it, and theirs under them. - **Who is working, who waits for you.** A session at work (a subagent running or a plan step in progress) has a soft glint sweeping along the bottom of its frame in the graph. A session waiting on you (a permission dialog, a question, or a turn that ended on a question) knocks twice and rests, and says `● waiting for you` in the list. - **Filters.** `● Plans ● Agents ● Skills` — turn any of them off. With plans off the graph becomes a timeline. - **All-time statistics.** Which skills and subagent types you use most, counted from every transcript on your machine.

Plans filtered out: the trunk becomes a time axis.
Statistics, opened from the bottom-right corner.
The animation and screenshots use made-up demo data. ## What's new in 0.4

- **Working sessions glint.** A soft glint sweeps along the bottom of every session at work. - **Sessions that need you knock.** A permission dialog, a question, or a turn that ended on a question makes the frame knock twice, then rest. The list says `● waiting for you`. - **Working sessions come first.** Other sessions at work are listed above idle ones. - **Less clutter.** Finished subagents that ran outside a plan step fold under `▸ Finished subagents` once you send the next message. - **Token usage, Codex and Gemini** (0.2–0.3): see above. Full notes on the [releases page](https://github.com/qaokss/claude-agents-view/releases). ## Install At the prompt of a Claude Code terminal session: ``` /plugin install subagents-pane --marketplace qaokss/claude-agents-view ``` Answer `y` to add the marketplace, then pick a scope (user scope loads it in every session). From a shell: ```bash claude plugin install subagents-pane --marketplace qaokss/claude-agents-view ``` In the Claude desktop app, where `/plugin` does not run: click **+** next to the prompt box → **Plugins** → **Add marketplace** with `qaokss/claude-agents-view` → **Add plugin**. The pane opens by itself when a session starts. If you close it, bring it back with: ``` /agents-view ``` (`/subagents` does the same.) ## Using it | Control | Where | What it does | | --- | --- | --- | | `List │ Graph` | top right | Switches the view. The graph needs the desktop or mobile app; the terminal shows the list. | | `⚙` | top right | Settings: `● Token usage` shows or hides token counts. | | `● Plans ● Agents ● Skills` | under it | Shows or hides each kind, for all sessions at once. | | `▸` / `▾` | left of a session | Folds what hangs off a session; its name stays. | | `collapse all` | above other sessions | Folds or unfolds every other session. | | `▸ Past plans`, `▸ Finished subagents`, `▸ Used skills` | inside a session | Earlier work, folded by default. In the graph, subagents that ran outside a plan step fold under `▸ Finished subagents` once you send the next message or a new plan starts. | | `Statistics ▴` | bottom right | Opens the all-time ranking of skills and subagent types. | Folds, the chosen view, filters and settings are remembered per session. ## How it works It is a Claude Code **hooks module** (`hooks/register.tsx`) — no server, no network. - **Plans** come from Claude's own task-list tool calls; **subagents** from `agent.spawn` and their turns; **skills** from `Skill` tool calls; **tool counts** from each subagent's tool calls. - **Sharing between sessions:** every session writes a small JSON snapshot to `~/.claude/mods-data/subagents-pane/sessions/` once a second when something changes (and a heartbeat every 30 s). The pane reads the others' snapshots, listing sessions at work (a subagent running or a plan step in progress) first; a session that stops updating disappears after 90 s. - **Tokens** come from the engine: a subagent's `tokenCount` in `$.agent.list()` (its latest request's input plus all its output, the figure Claude Code's own agent list shows), the session's from `$.session.usage()`. - **Codex and Gemini runs** are Bash calls whose command starts `codex`, `gemini`, `npx @openai/codex` or `npx @google/gemini-cli`. Neither CLI reports to Claude Code, so the pane reads the session log each one keeps, only the new part (`tail -c +N`) every 3 s while the run lasts: Codex's `$CODEX_HOME/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-*.jsonl` (`session_meta`, `token_count`, `task_complete`; a subagent's log names its parent thread) and Gemini's `~/.gemini/tmp//chats/session-*.jsonl` (per-message `tokens`; a subagent's chat sits in `chats//`). A run's log is the first one its CLI began, after the call, in the folder the command works in (`cd … &&`, Codex's `-C`). Tokens are counted as for Claude: the last request's input plus all output. A run in the foreground ends when its Bash call returns; in the background, at Codex's `task_complete`, or once a Gemini chat ends on the model's answer and stays still for 20 s. - **Session names** are the chat titles Claude Code keeps next to each transcript (`custom-title.json`). - **Statistics** scan your transcripts in `~/.claude/projects` with `grep` while the statistics card is open (every 30 s), counting each `Skill` and `Agent` call once. - **Pictures** in graph view are SVGs drawn by `hooks/graph.ts`, animated with SMIL, sized to the pane. Everything stays on your machine. ## Development ```bash claude plugin validate . claude plugin test . ``` Tests live in `tests/pane.test.tsx` and run the module against the engine with mocked clock, files and processes. Built and tested with Claude Code 2.1.321–2.1.325. The hooks-module API is in early access and may change between releases. ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

import type { AgentStatusWord, SkillStatus } from '../types'

// Every word the pane and its pictures show, in one place.

const enPlural = (n: number, one: string, many: string) => (n === 1 ? one : many)

export type Words = {
  title: string
  commandDescription: string
  opened: string
  sessions: (n: number) => string
  list: string
  graph: string
  show: string
  plans: string
  agents: string
  skills: string
  allHidden: string
  allHiddenDot: string
  nothingYet: string
  statistics: string
  allTime: (sessions: number) => string
  noCallsYet: string
  noDataYet: string
  skillCalls: (n: number) => string
  agentRuns: (n: number) => string
  more: (n: number) => string
  fold: string
  replaced: string
  noDescription: string
  calls: (n: number) => string
  skillsCount: (n: number) => string
  usedSkills: (n: number) => string
  subagentsCount: (n: number) => string
  finishedSubagents: (n: number) => string
  pastPlans: (n: number) => string
  pastPlansWithAgents: (n: number, agents: number) => string
  untitled: string
  runningAgents: (n: number) => string
  otherSessions: (n: number) => string
  foldAll: string
  unfoldAll: string
  thisSession: string
  planCount: (done: number, total: number) => string
  sessionAlt: (name: string, steps: number, agents: number) => string
  pastPlanAlt: (steps: number) => string
  // pictures
  agentStatus: Record<AgentStatusWord, string>
  skillStatus: Record<SkillStatus, string>
  callsChip: string
  noTools: string
  toolCalls: (n: number) => string
  skillWord: string
  stepDropped: string
  thisSessionTip: string
  runningTip: (n: number) => string
  durationS: (s: number) => string
  // tokens & settings
  settings: string
  showTokens: string
  tokens: (n: number) => string
  inContext: (n: number) => string
  waitingForYou: string
}

const en: Words = {
  title: 'Agents, skills & plans',
  commandDescription: 'Show what agents, skills and plans are doing',
  opened: 'Agents, skills & plans view opened.',
  sessions: n => `${n} ${enPlural(n, 'session', 'sessions')}`,
  list: 'List',
  graph: 'Graph',
  show: 'Show:',
  plans: 'Plans',
  agents: 'Agents',
  skills: 'Skills',
  allHidden: 'Everything is filtered out',
  allHiddenDot: 'Everything is filtered out.',
  nothingYet: 'No plan, no subagents yet.',
  statistics: 'Statistics',
  allTime: n => `All time · ${n} ${enPlural(n, 'session', 'sessions')}`,
  noCallsYet: 'No calls yet',
  noDataYet: 'No data yet — it appears after the first skills and subagents',
  skillCalls: n => `Skills · ${n} ${enPlural(n, 'call', 'calls')}`,
  agentRuns: n => `Subagents · ${n} ${enPlural(n, 'run', 'runs')}`,
  more: n => `${n} more`,
  fold: 'collapse',
  replaced: 'replaced',
  noDescription: 'No description',
  calls: n => `${n} ${enPlural(n, 'call', 'calls')}`,
  skillsCount: n => `Skills · ${n}`,
  usedSkills: n => `Used skills (${n})`,
  subagentsCount: n => `Subagents · ${n}`,
  finishedSubagents: n => `Finished subagents (${n})`,
  pastPlans: n => `Past plans (${n})`,
  pastPlansWithAgents: (n, a) => `Past plans (${n})${a ? ` · ${a} ${enPlural(a, 'subagent', 'subagents')}` : ''}`,
  untitled: 'Untitled session',
  runningAgents: n => `${n} ${enPlural(n, 'subagent', 'subagents')} running`,
  otherSessions: n => `Other sessions · ${n}`,
  foldAll: 'collapse all',
  unfoldAll: 'expand all',
  thisSession: 'this session',
  planCount: (d, t) => `Plan · ${d}/${t}`,
  sessionAlt: (name, s, a) => `${name}: plan of ${s} steps, ${a} subagents`,
  pastPlanAlt: s => `Past plan: ${s} steps`,
  agentStatus: {
    pending: 'pending',
    running: 'running',
    waiting: 'waiting',
    idle: 'idle',
    completed: 'done',
    failed: 'failed',
    killed: 'stopped',
  },
  skillStatus: { active: 'active', used: 'used', failed: 'failed' },
  callsChip: 'calls',
  noTools: 'no tool calls',
  toolCalls: n => `tool calls: ${n}`,
  skillWord: 'skill',
  stepDropped: '(the plan was replaced before this step)',
  thisSessionTip: ' (this session)',
  runningTip: n => `${n} ${enPlural(n, 'subagent', 'subagents')} running`,
  durationS: s => (s < 60 ? `${s}s` : s < 3600 ? `${Math.floor(s / 60)}m ${s % 60}s` : `${Math.floor(s / 3600)}h ${Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60)}m`),
  settings: 'Settings',
  showTokens: 'Token usage',
  tokens: n => `${shortCount(n)} tokens`,
  inContext: n => `${shortCount(n)} in context`,
  waitingForYou: '● waiting for you',
}

/** 950 → «950», 142 812 → «142.8k», 1 520 000 → «1.52M». */
export const shortCount = (n: number) =>
  n < 1000 ? String(Math.round(n)) : n < 1_000_000 ? `${(n / 1000).toFixed(1)}k` : `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(2)}M`

export const WORDS: Words = en
files.tests/pane.test.tsx:
import { expect, mock, test } from 'claude-code/testing'

import { runDir, vendorOf } from '../hooks/external'

const PANE = {
  plugin: 'subagents-pane',
  component: 'Pane',
  requestId: 'subagents',
  props: {
    title: 'Agents, skills & plans',
    isFocused: false,
    bodyColumns: 40,
    placement: 'dock',
    scroll: { offset: 0, bodyRows: 20 },
    view: {},
  },
} as const

test('a spawned subagent shows with its task and status', async ($, on) => {
  const clock = mock.clock(on, { now: 1_000_000 })
  on('command.register', () => ({ value: { command: 'subagents' } }))
  on('ui.open', () => ({ value: { isPlaced: true } }))
  on('session.start', (_, e) => ({ cwd: e.cwd }))
  on('agent.list', () => ({ value: [] }))
  on('agent.spawn', () => ({ model: 'claude-haiku-5-5', agentId: 'a1' }))
  on('turn.complete', () => ({ text: 'ok' }))

  await $.session.start({ cwd: '/', surface: 'desktop', isInteractive: true })

  const empty = await $.ui.mount({ ...PANE, surface: 'desktop' })
  expect(await empty.find({ type: 'Text', text: /No plan, no subagents yet/ })).toBeTruthy()
  await empty.unmount()

  await $.agent.spawn({ prompt: 'Find every TODO in src', description: 'Find TODOs', subagentType: 'Explore' } as never)

  await clock.advance(65_000)

  for (const surface of ['terminal', 'desktop', 'vscode', 'mobile'] as const) {
    const ui = await $.ui.mount({ ...PANE, surface })
    expect((await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /Find TODOs/ }))?.text).toBe('Find TODOs')
    expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /^◐$/ })).toBeTruthy()
    expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /^1:05$/ })).toBeTruthy()
    expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /Explore · 0 calls/ })).toBeTruthy()
    expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /Subagents · 1/ })).toBeTruthy()
    await ui.unmount()
  }
})

test('a finished turn marks the subagent done', async ($, on) => {
  mock.clock(on)
  on('agent.list', () => ({ value: [] }))
  on('agent.spawn', () => ({ model: 'claude-haiku-5-5', agentId: 'a2' }))
  on('turn.complete', () => ({ text: 'ok' }))

  await $.agent.spawn({ prompt: 'Run tests', description: 'Tests', subagentType: 'general-purpose' } as never)
  await $.turn.complete({ turnId: 't1', agentId: 'a2', reason: 'answer', answer: 'done' } as never)

  const ui = await $.ui.mount({ ...PANE, surface: 'terminal' })
  expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /Finished subagents \(1\)/ })).toBeTruthy()
  expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /^Tests$/ })).toBeFalsy()
  await ui.press({ key: 'btn-done:' })
  expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /^Tests$/ })).toBeTruthy()
  expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /^✓$/ })).toBeTruthy()
  await ui.unmount()
})

test('the plan list shows its steps as they move', async ($, on) => {
  mock.clock(on)
  on('agent.list', () => ({ value: [] }))
  on('tool.call', () => ({ result: {} }))

  await $.tool.call({ tool: 'mcp__ccd_turn__update_plan', items: [
    { content: 'Step one', status: 'in_progress' },
    { content: 'Step two', status: 'pending' },
  ] } as never)
  await $.tool.call({ tool: 'mcp__ccd_turn__update_plan', advance: true } as never)

  const ui = await $.ui.mount({ ...PANE, surface: 'desktop' })
  expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /Plan/ })).toBeTruthy()
  expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /Step two/ })).toBeTruthy()
  expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /^◐$/ })).toBeTruthy()
  expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /^✓$/ })).toBeTruthy()
  await ui.unmount()
})

test('other sessions show up from the shared folder', async ($, on) => {
  const clock = mock.clock(on, { now: 5_000_000 })
  const dir = '/home/u/.claude/mods-data/subagents-pane/sessions'
  const other = {
    sessionId: 'other-1', title: '', folder: 'demo-app', topic: 'Review the call screen',
    plan: [{ content: 'Call status badge', status: 'in_progress' }],
    history: [],
    agents: [{ id: 'x1', description: 'UI review', type: 'ui-designer', prompt: 'Check', status: 'running', startedAt: 4_990_000, toolCalls: 3 }],
    updatedAt: 4_999_000,
  }
  const written: string[] = []
  on('command.register', () => ({ value: { command: 'subagents' } }))
  on('ui.open', () => ({ value: { isPlaced: true } }))
  on('session.start', (_, e) => ({ cwd: e.cwd }))
  on('session.id', () => ({ value: 'me-1' }))
  on('agent.list', () => ({ value: [] }))
  on('env.get', () => ({ value: '/home/u' }))
  on('fs.exists', () => ({ value: true }))
  on('fs.write', (_, e) => (written.push((e as { path: string }).path), { value: undefined }))
  on('fs.list', () => ({ value: [
    { name: 'me-1.json', kind: 'file', size: 1, mtimeMs: 4_999_000, isLink: false },
    { name: 'other-1.json', kind: 'file', size: 1, mtimeMs: 4_999_000, isLink: false },
  ] }))
  on('fs.read', () => ({ value: JSON.stringify(other) }))

  await $.session.start({ cwd: '/Users/u/scratch', surface: 'desktop', isInteractive: true })
  await clock.advance(1_000)

  const ui = await $.ui.mount({ ...PANE, surface: 'desktop' })
  expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /this session/ })).toBeTruthy()

const iso = (ms: number) => new Date(ms).toISOString()
const bytes = (s: string) => new TextEncoder().encode(s).length
/** A fake disk: files by path, and the listing each folder gives. */
type TestOn = Parameters<Extract<Parameters<typeof test>[1], (...args: never[]) => unknown>>[1]
const disk = (on: TestOn, files: Record<string, string>, mtime: () => number) => {
  on('fs.list', (_, e) => {
    const dir = String((e as { path?: string }).path).replace(/\/+$/, '')
    const names = new Map<string, 'file' | 'dir'>()
    for (const p of Object.keys(files)) {
      if (!p.startsWith(`${dir}/`)) continue
      const rest = p.slice(dir.length + 1).split('/')
      names.set(rest[0]!, rest.length > 1 ? 'dir' : 'file')
    }
    return { value: [...names].map(([name, kind]) => ({
      name, kind, size: kind === 'file' ? bytes(files[`${dir}/${name}`]!) : 0, mtimeMs: kind === 'file' ? mtime() : 0, isLink: false,
    })) }
  })
  on('fs.read', (_, e) => {
    const { path, offset = 0 } = e as { path: string; offset?: number }
    const text = files[path]
    if (text === undefined) throw new Error('missing')
    return { value: new TextDecoder().decode(new TextEncoder().encode(text).slice(offset)) }
  })
  on('fs.exists', (_, e) => ({ value: String((e as { path?: string }).path) in files }))
  // `tail -c +N path`: the file from byte N on
  on('process.run', (_, e) => {
    const [cmd, , from, path] = (e as { argv: string[] }).argv
    const text = cmd === 'tail' ? files[path!] : undefined
    if (text === undefined) return { value: { exitCode: 1, stdout: '', stderr: 'missing', isStdoutTruncated: false, isStderrTruncated: false } }
    const rest = new TextDecoder().decode(new TextEncoder().encode(text).slice(Number(from!.slice(1)) - 1))
    return { value: { exitCode: 0, stdout: rest, stderr: '', isStdoutTruncated: false, isStderrTruncated: false } }
  })
}

test('a session at work glints along its frame, and one waiting on the user knocks', async ($, on) => {
  const clock = mock.clock(on, { now: 6_000_000 })
  on('command.register', () => ({ value: { command: 'subagents' } }))
  on('ui.open', () => ({ value: { isPlaced: true } }))
  on('session.start', (_, e) => ({ cwd: e.cwd }))
  on('agent.list', () => ({ value: [] }))
  on('prompt.submit', (_, e) => e)
  on('classic.PermissionRequest', () => ({}))
  let answer: (() => void) | undefined
  on('tool.call', async (_, e) => {
    const tool = (e as { tool: string }).tool
    if (tool === 'AskUserQuestion' || tool === 'Bash') await new Promise<void>(r => (answer = r))
    return { result: { answers: {}, stdout: '', stderr: '', interrupted: false } }
  })

  await $.session.start({ cwd: '/', surface: 'desktop', isInteractive: true })
  await $.tool.call({ tool: 'mcp__ccd_turn__update_plan', items: [{ content: 'Build', status: 'in_progress' }] } as never)
  await clock.advance(1_000)

  const svgs = async () => {
    const ui = await $.ui.mount({ ...PANE, surface: 'desktop' })
    await ui.press({ key: 'btn-view-graph' })
    const json = JSON.stringify(await ui.findAll({ type: 'Svg' }))
    // the class on an element, not the style sheet's rule
    const svg = ['glint', 'knock'].filter(c => new RegExp(`class=\\\\+"${c}`).test(json)).join(' ')
    await ui.unmount()
    // the list (the terminal draws no graph) says it in words
    const list = await $.ui.mount({ ...PANE, surface: 'terminal' })
    const waitingText = !!(await list.find({ type: 'Text', text: /waiting for you/ }))
    await list.unmount()
    return { svg, waitingText }
  }
  // a step in progress: the glint runs, nothing knocks
  let now1 = await svgs()
  expect(now1.svg).toContain('glint')
  expect(now1.svg).not.toContain('knock')

  // a question for the user: knocks once it has waited a moment
  const call = $.tool.call({ tool: 'AskUserQuestion', questions: [] } as never)
  await clock.advance(500)
  now1 = await svgs()
  expect(now1.svg).not.toContain('knock')
  await clock.advance(3_000)
  now1 = await svgs()
  expect(now1.svg).toContain('knock')
  expect(now1.svg).not.toContain('glint')
  expect(now1.waitingText).toBe(true)

  // answered: back to the glint
  answer!()
  await call
  await clock.advance(1_000)
  now1 = await svgs()
  expect(now1.svg).not.toContain('knock')
  expect(now1.svg).toContain('glint')

  // a permission dialog shown to the user knocks; an ask nobody is shown does not
  const bash = $.tool.call({ tool: 'Bash', command: 'make', description: 'Build' } as never)
  await clock.advance(3_000)
  now1 = await svgs()
  expect(now1.svg).not.toContain('knock')
  await $.classic.PermissionRequest({ tool_name: 'Bash', tool_input: { command: 'make' } } as never)
  await clock.advance(3_000)
  now1 = await svgs()
  expect(now1.svg).toContain('knock')
  answer!()
  await bash
  await clock.advance(1_000)
  now1 = await svgs()
  expect(now1.svg).not.toContain('knock')

  // a turn that ends on a question for the user waits until their message
  await $.tool.call({ tool: 'mcp__ccd_turn__wrap_up', recap: 'x', ask: 'Go?', blocked: true } as never)
  await clock.advance(3_000)
  now1 = await svgs()
  expect(now1.svg).toContain('knock')
  await $.prompt.submit({ text: 'go' } as never)
  await clock.advance(1_000)
  now1 = await svgs()
  expect(now1.svg).not.toContain('knock')
  expect(now1.svg).not.toContain('glint')
})
